description: Mearns Canine Lodge is a dog boarding and daycare facility set within the Star and Garter Estate in Newton Mearns. description: Birdston Kennels is a boarding facility located on Birdston Road between Kirkintilloch and Milton of Campsie, situated within 120 acres of countryside. description: Chilled Dawgz is a licensed dog daycare centre situated in Dalsetter Business Centre on Dalsetter Avenue in Glasgow.
